newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica to sue Romania over GSM license.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to sue Romania over GSM license.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica de Espana plans to sue the Romanian government to block it from holding a tender for two GSM mobile telephone licenses, a company source told Reuters on Tuesday.
Telefonica claims it was promised the right to offer digital mobile telephone service when it started providing analogue service in Bucharest, the Romanian capital, in 1992.
The source said Telefonica would take legal action against the winners of the bid if the company failed to stop Romania from going ahead.
Three consortia have submitted bids to date and the Romanian ministry said 60 companies had purchased the tender documents.
The closing date for the tender is September 26.
Marcial Protela, managing director of TISA, Telefonica's international unit, travelled to Bucharest on Tuesday to meet the Romanian communications minister.
The Spanish operator is using U.S. law firm Steptoe & Johnson to file suit in several international arbitration tribunals, the source said.
